subject.title: feat(providers): add local Lume macOS leases

question: After the authentication boundary is hardened, should Crabbox permanently support Lume as another built-in local macOS provider with dedicated configuration and image-preparation hooks?
rationale: The repository already has a provider-neutral adapter architecture, but choosing which local runtimes receive permanent built-in registration, documentation, and support is a product-surface decision that cannot be inferred from technical correctness alone.

options.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
options.body: Keep the provider in core after key-only SSH, focused compatibility review, and inspectable Apple-silicon lifecycle proof are supplied.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Decline the built-in configuration and registration surface and document the provider extension boundary needed for an independently maintained integration.

options.title: Pause pending narrower scope
options.body: Retain the draft while evaluating a doctor-only or experimental surface with fewer permanent support commitments.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
recommendation.body: Keep the provider in core after key-only SSH, focused compatibility review, and inspectable Apple-silicon lifecycle proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release integration history provides the strongest available signal for ownership of built-in provider-surface decisions.
